subject.title: fix: recover updater from late launchd bootout errors

question: Should the late-bootout recovery land as this narrow branch, or should its stricter proof semantics be consolidated into the broader https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105022 candidate?
rationale: Both branches modify the same availability-critical stop/proof state machine, neither contains the other, and the broader candidate covers additional live-reproduced failures; automation should not choose which competing implementation becomes canonical.

options.title: Consolidate into the broader candidate
options.body: Carry this branch's launchd-authoritative proof requirement into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105022 and land one fix for both live-reproduced paths.

options.title: Land the narrow recovery
options.body: Merge this PR independently and keep the canonical issue plus broader candidate open for delayed-success teardown and wrapper plist repair.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Hold both PRs until the updater owner selects one retry policy and validates the combined state machine.

recommendation.title: Consolidate into the broader candidate
recommendation.body: Carry this branch's launchd-authoritative proof requirement into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105022 and land one fix for both live-reproduced paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current updater state machine, canonical issue, and both competing repair branches.
